newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Apr-Aug budget deficit below 5-yr average.
newsitem.headline: Indian Apr-Aug budget deficit below 5-yr average.

text.p: The Indian Finance Ministry said on Tuesday that the federal budgetary deficit between April and August totalled 109.17 billion rupees, down from an average of 169.90 billion over the same five-month period in the last five fiscal years.
The ministry released a table of figures which were mentioned by Finance Minister P. Chidambaram in remarks earlier on Tuesday to the World Economic Forum.

The figures compared receipts, expenditures and the revenue deficit for April-August as a percentage of the projected budget estimate of those categories for all of 1996/97 (April-March), with the average for the first five months of the last five fiscal years:
